description:
A team of long-lived bots for DeepSeek Harness.

DeepSeek Bot (DS Bot) is a bot plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that turns DSH into long-lived bots. You create your own bots, then talk and work with them, with bot-to-bot messages and group chats.

The desktop app brings its own DSH, so you do not need to install DSH first. Bots can run tools, keep their own memory and files, and answer side questions while they work.
Added
- macOS in-place auto-update: macOS desktop builds can now download, SHA-256 verify, and atomically replace DS Bot.app in place without manually re-downloading the DMG. (#2392)
- Auto web-fetch with isolated browser fallback: added an automatic web-fetch provider that falls back from direct HTTP fetch to an isolated, SSRF-guarded browser render for JS-heavy and anti-bot pages. (#2421)
- Visible pause guards for runaway loops and retries: Bots now pause visibly with a clear resume option instead of burning tokens on stuck tool loops or repeated retries. (#2424)
Changed
- Smooth Bot sidebar collapse & expand motion: switched the Bot sidebar collapse and expand animation to critically damped motion without layout jitter. (#2431)
- Browser plugin catalog cleanup: removed Ego Lite from the built-in browser plugin catalog while preserving safe switch and uninstall paths for existing installations. (#2398)
Fixed
- ChatGPT subscription prompt cache hit rate: kept system prompts inline as developer messages in the cached input prefix, forwarded session affinity headers (session-id / x-client-request-id), populated prompt_cache_options, and preserved reasoning.encrypted_content across multi-step tool calls. (#2408)
- ChatGPT subscription reasoning effort: exposed and preserved selectable reasoning effort levels for ChatGPT-plan models in Bot settings and the model switcher. (#2399)
- Desktop scheduled tasks entry & one-click enablement: fixed clicking Scheduled Tasks in the desktop app account menu failing to open and enabled one-click schedule setup on DSH 0.2.2. (#2439)
- Composer input locks & focus stealing: fixed unexpected focus stealing and states that prevented typing in chat sessions. (#2422)
- Narrow settings & UI overflow fixes: stacked narrow input and picker rows instead of squeezing labels, fixed narrow switch-row clipping, and resolved missing border-box width overflows across settings and detail panels. (#2420, #2426)
- Window dragging with modals open: kept the top window drag strip responsive while modals and overlays are open. (#2423)
- External browser plugin sidebar status: distinguished external browser plugins from the built-in sidebar browser panel so controls and indicators stay accurate. (#2393)
- DSH plugin startup & SQLite shutdown stability: fixed an uiSession.sessionStatus inject crash in DSH plugin host mode and prevented chat-index and usage SQLite handles from reopening or leaking during shutdown while flushing active metered usage. (#2403, #2411)
